Bug_Title: python -m osdagbridge.desktop fails with No module named osdagbridge.desktop.__main__
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Install official application via 'pip install -e .'. 2. Run documented launch command 'python -m osdagbridge.desktop'.
Expected_Result: Desktop application window should launch cleanly or provide __main__ bootstrap script.
Actual_Result: Fails immediately with: 'No module named osdagbridge.desktop.__main__; osdagbridge.desktop is a package and cannot be directly executed'.

Bug_Title: Desktop bootstrap main.py is an unlinked console stub instead of initializing PySide6 GUI
Expected_Result: Should instantiate QApplication and display OsdagBridge desktop interface.
Actual_Result: Prints only 'Starting desktop UI (stub)' to stdout without initiating any graphical window.

Bug_Title: Preliminary sizing routine returns raw DTO string instead of calculated girder depth
Expected_Result: Should calculate preliminary depth based on span-to-depth ratio (Span/12 to Span/15).
Actual_Result: Returns literal string dict {'depth_m': dto.name} bypassing numerical structural evaluation.

Bug_Title: Zero web thickness in girder section produces unhandled ZeroDivisionError in slenderness calculation
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Construct girder section. 2. Set web_thickness = 0.0 mm. 3. Trigger slenderness ratio check.
Expected_Result: Input validator should catch non-positive thickness with ERR_NEGATIVE_OR_ZERO_INPUT.
Actual_Result: Unhandled ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero raised in slenderness calculation d/tw.

Bug_Title: Numeric input fields permit raw alphabetic characters during rapid keystrokes
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Focus on numeric Web Depth input. 2. Paste '1800ABC_INJECTION'. 3. Trigger submit.
Expected_Result: Should immediately reject non-numeric characters with inline validation feedback.
Actual_Result: Accepts raw string until deferred validation halts execution with ERR_INVALID_DATA_TYPE.

Bug_Title: PDF report export fails silently when destination path contains Unicode characters
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Calculate valid bridge design. 2. Export report to folder path containing Unicode characters 'C:\Bridge\डिजाइन\report.pdf'.
Expected_Result: Report file should be written and user alerted to success.
Actual_Result: Export dialogue closes without creating file; no error alert surfaced to user interface.

Bug_Title: Impact factor calculation for spans exceeding 45m falls below IRC:6 statutory floor of 0.10
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Set span length to 50.0m. 2. Evaluate impact formula 4.5 / (6.0 + span).
Expected_Result: Impact factor must be clamped to minimum 0.10 for steel highway bridges per IRC:6 Cl 208.
Actual_Result: Unclamped formula evaluated to 0.0803 without enforcing lower bound.

Bug_Title: Missing models.py in osdagbridge.core causes unhandled ModuleNotFoundError on package import
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. Execute 'import osdagbridge.core'. 2. Python executes src/osdagbridge/core/__init__.py which contains 'from .models import *'.
Expected_Result: Should import core package models without missing submodule errors.
Actual_Result: Raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'osdagbridge.core.models' because models.py is absent from repository.
